intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Royal Physician Dorrance approaches with his hat held humbly in both hands. It doesn’t suit him.

intro.speaker: PHYSICIAN
intro.text: “Your Highness. A purely academic question. A stable hand has a rash that four rounds of leeches have failed to improve.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Senna goes very still, like a cat that has just been handed the ribbon.

intro.speaker: SENNA
intro.text: “Doctor Leeches is asking me for help. Out loud. With witnesses.”

options.labelText: “Make him ask again in front of the whole court. He’s earned it.”

branch.speaker: SENNA
branch.text: “Nine seconds of satisfaction. Then he leeches the stable hand again, out of spite.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She gives Dorrance the answer in one flat sentence. He’s gone before she can enjoy any of it.

options.labelText: “You don’t owe him anything. Let him work it out himself.”

branch.speaker: SENNA
branch.text: “The stable hand would like him to work it out faster.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She tells Dorrance briskly, the way she’d hand back a glove he dropped.

options.labelText: “Help him. Then gloat to me afterward. In detail.”

branch.speaker: SENNA
branch.text: “New saddle soap. Change it. Stop the leeches. Mostly stop the leeches.”

branch.speaker: PHYSICIAN
branch.text: “The saddle soap. Of course. I was coming to that.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: When he’s gone, she opens her notebook to a fresh page and writes *Gloating* across the top.
